long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Nicosia, Joannou attended school in Athens before earning civil-engineering degrees at Cornell and Columbia, followed by a doctorate in architecture from Rome's Sapienza University. He entered Joannou & Paraskevaides in 1967 and spent years travelling as the contractor expanded across the Middle East, North Africa and southeastern Europe. His portfolio eventually reached hospitality, property, shipping, aviation and beverage bottling.

Art developed into a second defining pursuit. A 1985 visit to Jeff Koons's Equilibrium exhibition led him to buy One Ball Total Equilibrium Tank and shaped a long association with artists and curators. Through DESTE, he has presented ambitious exhibitions, commissioned new work and offered platforms to younger talent. The foundation now operates in Athens and maintains a seasonal project space in a former slaughterhouse on Hydra.
